options.content: **Pi:** accepted edits, Git actions, matched tool-result content, model context-window utilization, full child consumption, session history, log/trace timeline and member budgets are unavailable on this dashboard. Agent runs are not session counts. **OpenCode:** tool/run/model breakdown, sessions, edits, Git, logs/traces, context-window and member budgets are unavailable; only finalized assistant usage/cost is a tested plugin candidate. No real 2.2.6 compatibility proof. Empty supported charts mean no observed samples, not zero. No content is collected.
